notes.title: Update Version S1.30
notes.content:
The latest patch has been deployed and should be available for download.
Changes
-Bot AI has been modified to help with getting stuck/not attacking sometimes.
-Reload and No Ammo warning messages are visible on the hud again.
-Enemy Spawns on Beach have been tweaked a little, and Workers move a little quicker.
-The Tacklebox on Beach has been redone, and should now look more climbable.
-Trigger volumes modified in the back room of Basement.

notes.title: The Next Update
notes.content:
It was a little bit of a bumpy start, but we managed to have a smooth run for the last week or so. We have had no major error or game breaking bug reports which is always a plus. There has been some excellent feedback though, and we have spotted a few things ourselves, so we are working on a small update that we will deploy sometime over the next few weeks.

[h1]Get your suggestions in quick![/h1]
So far the updates have been for one or two major issues each, so we are spending more time on this update to get as much done as possible. The more we can improve now in these early days the better for everyone. We are always testing the game ourselves, but we are only two people and we unfortunately don't have the benefit of having a large team, full of diverse views and opinions, so your feedback is most important to us.
We have also added another Discussion Topic here on Steam, that may help anyone still having issues with online multiplayer. Be sure to have a look.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Released and Ready to Play
notes.content:
Yesterday we finally released Toy Wars Invasion on Steam. I hope everyone playing is enjoying themselves and not running into too many issues. Unfortunately, there is a problem with the Server Browser currently, which has decided not to work for the release build... Conveniently enough for us. This is a major problem for us and we are trying to resolve these issues as quickly as possible, be prepared for a hot fix very soon! We Assure you the Multi-Player is Functional, and manual connections via the console command may still be achieved. Details can be found in the new Bug Thread.

[h1]Update Incoming[/h1]
Besides the hotfix, there will be another patch coming to address some issues players are having with repetitive audio and 'missing' settings in the options menu. We are Listening! Please use the forums or New Bug Thread here on the steam community to report your issues and suggestions.

Thanks For Playing!

notes.title: Test Results
notes.content:
Well here we are, not long now at all before everyone can get their hands on a Party Popper, or a Laser Pistol and blast some Twisted Toys into pieces. To be honest, the feedback has been rather minimal. We have had some bugs fixed and some things tweaked. Otherwise it has been good...Well at least nothing bad has been brought to our attention.
[h1]Future Updates[/h1]
We have been waiting for this for a long time, and we want this to be something Everyone can enjoy, and be proud of. Though the Release is upon us, this is not the end! If you see something strange, have a suggestion, or are having issues with the game, we strongly encourage you to report your issues either to the [url=http://www.toywarsinvasion.com/comj/phpBB3/index.php] official forums [/url] or the Community Forum here on Steam. For now though we hope the game Behaves for everyone playing, and that you have a Wonderful Time doing so.
Thanks for Visiting, See you all Very Soon!

notes.title: Almost There!
notes.content:
Not long now, just a few short weeks and you'll be able to tear your way through the hordes of Unwanted causing chaos in the world with all of your friends. Or against them if it pleases you... We have 'talked' a lot about what we have been doing behind the scenes, and now its time to show you!
Starting with the workers, who had the animation overhaul.
[img]http://orig01.deviantart.net/4f3d/f/2015/110/9/4/9462ae22c09c14e3cfa392769db8121e-d8qi3cy.jpg[/img]
Its not much but you spend a lot of time following them around, so we felt we'd give them a bit more love.
Next up. The New Damage Features.
The Goliath's mainly, as they slightly differ from the changes we made to the wizards and ballerinas. Now you can tell when you've hurt them.
[img]http://orig12.deviantart.net/83d8/f/2015/110/f/d/fd98dfd0ed54ad5c17e6d98994511980-d8qi3cq.jpg[/img]
and of course, the fire.
[img]http://orig15.deviantart.net/bf41/f/2015/110/4/a/4ac75bc886b6fdc8aa63169b250c61a5-d8qi3co.jpg[/img]
Burn, baby, Burn! The Firestarter turns everything to ash, even the ballerinas pretty dress is not safe from the blackening flames!
[h1] Home Stretch [/h1]
We are the stage again where we will soon be looking at some extra testing from other parties. We want to make sure everything is working for everybody and not just us developers. We'll get back to you with the details soon and let you know how it goes.
We'll see you next time, Thanks for Visiting!

notes.title: Easter Update
notes.content:
[img]http://orig08.deviantart.net/ec3a/f/2015/095/e/d/easter_by_kingaz125-d8om3ff.png[/img]
Happy Easter Everybody, from us here on the Toy Wars Invasion team.
I hope you haven't eaten ALL your chocolate yet... Because everyone knows that's what this holiday's really about, The Treats! So we've brought you a few little special items ourselves, Enjoy!
[h1]Weapon's For Keepsies[/h1]
Buying a weapon now entitles it to you for the whole round, instead of resetting upon respawn. This was something we felt many players had an issue with in the initial release, so hopefully this will make tackling down those harder difficulty's more tolerable.
[h1]Damaged Enemies[/h1]
We mentioned previously about the Wizard's cracking under the pressure. We have also made changes to other enemies as well. All enemies that are burnt with the Firestarter are now visibly charred. Goliath's now start to show signs of damage and fatigue as they take damage, Including the Cyborg. Cannons are now Super Effective against Goliath's and their flammable fur.
[h1]Audio Overhaul[/h1]
We have a Brand New Announcer for the Solo and Co-Operative Objectives. All announcement messages have been redone in a different voice, with a whole new Personality! Along with various other changes that have been made to music volumes and sound effects throughout the game.
Thanks Everyone for Visiting, Have an Egg-cellent Holiday!

notes.title: Full Steam Ahead!
notes.content:
With preparations for the steam release well underway. Lets take a look at some of the features being on Steam will allow us to add and enhance your online experience in Toy Wars.
[img] http://orig10.deviantart.net/0b95/f/2015/089/2/0/newstuff_by_kingaz125-d8novoc.png[/img]
[h1][u] Achievements [/u][/h1]
A full set of Steam Achievements for you to earn and compare with your friends. Now you can show off to everyone how good you are at breaking stuff!
[h1][u] Stats & Leaderboards [/u][/h1]
Keep track of your destruction, healing and overall Awesomeness with the new Stats Page. The Stats Page can be found on the 'Extras' menu within the game. Think you've made a new high score? Now you can prove it.Thanks to the new stats system, we now have Leaderboards for you to compete on. Score, Kills, Healing, earn your title and show Flint who the real Top Dog is.
[h1][u] Trading Cards [/u][/h1]
Trading Cards are a hot item these days, Everyone just wants to get there hands on them. For Toy Wars we have brought you a set of 8 trading cards featuring a more life-like representation of some of the Unwanted Toys. Including a range of Badges, Emoticons and Profile Background rewards to go with it.

notes.title: New and Improved!
notes.content:
For those of you who have been tracking our progress since before our steam arrival. Here is few changes from the initial release that you can expect to see coming your way.
For anyone else jumping on board, we wish you a warm welcome to the Toy Wars Invasion community.

[h1][u] Enemy Overhaul [/u][/h1]
The difficulty scaling has had a major overhaul. The unwanted on lower difficulty's are now slower, and deal less damage. Insane mode has recieved a similar treatment, with a small move and attack speed [u]Increase[/u] to make them more aggressive. 'Safe Zone' checks have been added, and you should no longer get attack while Shopping at the Toy Box or spawning at a Checkpoint.

[h1][u] Comfortable Seating, Dancing Lessons and More! [/u][/h1]
Thats right, The Construction Workers now take a more relaxed seating position and have mastered the art of making it look like they are Working.
Ballerina's have been sent to dance class, and have come back with a little more poise, a little more grace... but still just as angry.
Wizard Statues and Porcelain Ballerinas now crack and shatter when destroyed, looks like the unwanted will be needing some extra super glue!

[h1][u] User Friendliness [/u][/h1]
Various user friendly functions and features added, including: 
[list]
[*]Automatic Reload when empty.
[*] Hints and Tips display added to the in game HUD.
[*] ToyBox and Enemy icons on the HUD
[*] Partial Controller Support added.
[/list]

The list goes on, but we'll leave it at that for now. Let us know if there's anything else we can do to improve the game for you. We know there is always room for improvement in any project. Feedback has been good so far, but More Detailed opinions are always welcomed and needed for us to provide you with a satisfactory product.

[h1][u]We're Here![/u][/h1]
We are pleased to announce the Toy Wars Invasion [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/346490] Store Page [/url] is now Live and will soon be available for purchase. The Steam release will feature an updated version with improved gameplay elements, and some New Features exclusive to Steam.

Stay Connected over the next few weeks as we provide more information about the updated version, and details about the New Features that we are working on.
